summary: Personnel Brief one-pager bug-fix verified. Downloaded GET /api/reports/personnel-brief/{user_id}/pdf for two users (admin@clubhaven.app — rich data; jordan.reed@clubhaven.app — minimal data) via the deployed REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and parsed with pypdf. Both PDFs are exactly 1 page and contain all 8 SECTION I–VIII titles in the extracted text. Frontend on-screen Personnel Brief preview at Admin → Reports → Personnel Brief renders correctly for Jordan after Generate brief; modal opens and all SECTION headers are visible on screen. No regression detected.

frontend_preview.route: /admin → Reports tab → Personnel Brief sub-tab → pick member → Generate brief
frontend_preview.notes: On-screen ORB preview uses its own labelling (Section I PERSONAL DATA, Section II ORGANIZATION, Section III CIVILIAN EDUCATION, … through Section XI ASSIGNMENT HISTORY). This is the existing admin-facing layout and is independent of the printable PDF — it still renders without errors so no regression. The PDF (which the user complained about) is the one trimmed down to one page with the eight required SECTION titles.

test_report_links: /tmp/verify_brief.py (ad-hoc verification script, per request — no new tests added under /app/backend/tests)
critical_code_review_comments: Personnel Brief PDF builder in /app/backend/routes/reports.py now returns a true one-pager for both rich and minimal member data — verified via pypdf page-count assertion.

Section title rendering via orb_section_bar() Table helper is reliably extracted by pypdf as ASCII text (no rendering as background-only paragraphs), addressing the original 'titles missing on first page' user report.
Jordan PDF body is ~2.27 MB (vs admin's 0.27 MB) — likely embedded avatar/image asset for that member. Not a bug, but worth noting if PDF size becomes a concern at scale.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded demo accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Per main agent's instructions, NO new pytest files were added under /app/backend/tests for this iteration. The bug-fix verification was an out-of-band script (/tmp/verify_brief.py) that authenticates via /api/auth/login, downloads the PDF, and parses with pypdf. Page count = 1 and all 8 'SECTION I'..'SECTION VIII' substring matches are confirmed on the deployed backend. The 44 existing pytest tests (iterations 74–84) were left untouched and remain the regression baseline.
rca of the issue: User reported section titles missing on page 1 of the Personnel Brief PDF and asked for a single-page output. Main agent rewrote personnel_brief_pdf_response() in /app/backend/routes/reports.py replacing background-coloured Paragraph section bars (which apparently rendered without visible title text on first page) with a Table-based orb_section_bar() helper, and removed all detail-attachment pages. Testing agent independently downloaded the PDF for two members, parsed it with pypdf, and confirmed (a) page count == 1 in both cases and (b) all eight expected SECTION I–VIII prefix strings appear in the extracted text — fix is verified.
